Address.description: A postal address (doc 03 §5). Its plain strings are NFC; the loader normalises them (module docs).

BasicProjectRef.description:
The basic project a project was created from (FR-PRJ-009): its project ID and its manifest
generation when it was copied (a basic project has no semantic version).

generation.description: The basic project's manifest generation when it was copied.

CarrierFixing.description: How a rail or a duct is fixed ([`WorkshopSettings::rail_fixing`], doc 12-3d §10.3).

from_end.description: How far the first and the last hole are from the ends.

pitch.description: At most how far apart two holes are.

ColourCode.description: An IEC 60757 or profile-declared company colour code, or {"foreign": code} (doc 05 §3.2).

Corner.description: A corner of a surface's sheet as its page shows it: the datum its holes are measured from (doc 12 §2.1).

Dec3.description: A canonical decimal string: at most three fraction digits, no trailing fraction zeros, no leading zeros, no plus sign, no "-0", no exponent, no white space, no unit (doc 05 §3.2). The pattern bounds the integer part to 16 digits; the exact i64 range of the thousandths (about 9.2 x 10^15) is checked by the reader.

Delimiter.description: The delimiter of a label file's CSV ([`ExportProfile::delimiter`]).

DeviceLabels.description: Where a device's label goes ([`WorkshopSettings::device_labels`], doc 13 §5.3).

oneOf.description: On the device and beside it, on the mounting plate: two labels.

ExportProfile.description: The columns of a label file ([`WorkshopSettings::label_profile`], doc 13 §5.4).

columns.description: The columns in file order: a column of the `labels` list and the heading the file prints.

delimiter.description: The CSV delimiter; absent: a comma.

FerruleRule.description: Which fine-stranded ends take a ferrule ([`WorkshopSettings::ferrules`], doc 13 §4.2).

oneOf.description:
Every fine-stranded end but those into a spring or push-in clamp, which holds the strands itself: the default
(the owner's shop rule, 2026-11-26).

FixingRule.description: How a fixing hole in the mounting plate is made ([`WorkshopSettings::fixing`], doc 12-3d §10.3).

oneOf.description: Tapped: drilled at the tap drill and tapped (the owner's default, 2026-11-26).
For a self-tapping screw: its pilot hole.
Through, with a nut: a clearance hole.

FluidSettings.description:
The project's fluid settings (doc 11 §2.4, §5.4): the default tube (level 1) and the line-tag scheme
(FR-FLU-011). `ProjectSettings.fluid`, optional and additive within format 0.1.

default_tube.description: The default tube of every fluid line.

line_tags.description: The line-tag scheme; absent: fluid lines carry no tag.

Formatting.description: Formatting conventions (doc 03 §5): date format, decimal separator and tag case sensitivity.

Ident.description: An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

oneOf.description: One star source refers to all others.

LabelFormat.description:
The project's one revision label format (doc 15 §5.2, FR-REV-002), `ProjectSettings.revision_label`;
absent means [`LabelFormat::VMajorMinor`], so every file written before the setting existed
reads as it did.

Labels increase in the format's own order ([`LabelFormat::order_key`]): `V2.0 < V10.0`, `09 < 10`, `Z < AA`.
That is not the natural (text) order everywhere: natural order puts `AA` before `Z`, so every ranking of
revisions orders by this key (labels outside the format, which it does not order, by their natural order).
The proposal for the next revision bumps the major part ([`LabelFormat::next`]).

oneOf.description: `V{major}.{minor}`: V1.0, V2.0, V2.1 (decimal parts without leading zeros).
`{nn}`: 00, 01 … 99, 100 (decimal, at least two digits: one leading zero below ten).
`{A}`: A, B … Z, AA, AB … (the letters without I and O, counted like spreadsheet columns).

LangTag.description: A canonical BCP 47 language tag such as en-GB (language in lower case, script in title case, region in upper case). JSON Schema cannot express that variant and extension subtags are unique; no registry is consulted, so qq-QQ is accepted.

LineTagScheme.description: How fluid lines are tagged (doc 11 §2.4, FR-FLU-011).

Marking.description: What a wire's marker says ([`WorkshopSettings::marking`], doc 13 §5.1).

oneOf.description: The far end, as seen from the end the marker sits on (the owner's choice, 2026-11-26).
This end, then the far end, on two lines.

description.description:
Project description ("Expansion Control Cabinets"); the title block prints it unless a page
overrides it (D-06).

document_title.description:
The cover subtitle ("Electrical Definition"), distinct from `long_description`
(doc 03 §5). Appended, since 0.1.

drawing_id.description: Drawing identification, separate from the project reference (FR-PRJ-002).

edited.description: Edited date: day precision, merged by maximum, feeds the "Saved" cell (FR-PRJ-029).

MlText.description: Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both.

Nm.description: A length in nanometres (doc 05 §3.2). Written without fraction or exponent; JSON Schema cannot tell 5 from 5.0, the reader rejects the latter.

PartRef.description: A part on a device (doc 03 §7): the embedded copy and an optional part variant (FR-PRT-003).

copy.description: The copy ID of the embedded part, `v5(NS_LIBCOPY, library ‖ item)`.

variant.description: A variant key of the part.

Party.description: A person or organisation in a role (doc 03 §5). Name and address are personal data (NFR-PRIV-06).

personal_data.description: Whether the party is a natural person whose data is personal data (FR-PRJ-024).

role.description: The role, bound by form cells (FR-PRJ-003, D-30).

oneOf.description: Panel builder (legal owner of the drawings).

key.description: The key of a column of the `labels` list (`text_1`).

ProjectLanguages.description: Source and translation languages of a project.

source.description: The language texts are authored in.

ProjectSettings.description:
Project settings (doc 03 §5). v0 types the settings with a field-level definition; numbering,
wire numbering, cross-reference format, colour and size profiles, check, manufacturing and frame
settings belong to their work packages and are kept in `extra` until then.

fluid.description:
The fluid settings: the default tube and the line-tag scheme (doc 11 §2.4, §5.4); optional and additive
within format 0.1 (ADR-0011 amendment 6).

identifier_set.description: The pinned identifier set by key, such as `"EN81346-2:2009"` (ADR-0026).

process_tag_scheme.description:
The process-tag scheme (FR-PLC-049, doc 10 §3.4): a regular expression with named groups that a whole
process tag must match (`(?P<area>TA\d\d)-(?P<kind>[A-Z]+)-(?P<number>\d+)`); EW-PRC-001 reports a tag that
does not. Absent: any tag.

revision_label.description:
The project's one revision label format (doc 15 §5.2, FR-REV-002); absent means
`v_major_minor` ([`ProjectSettings::revision_label_format`]).

text_styles.description:
The text styles as overrides of the built-in table, by style key (ADR-0032): a key of the
table takes the entry's size and weight, any other key adds a style. Absent is the built-in table.

typeface.description:
The project's typeface (doc 09 §4.8): the font file every text of the Standard typeface prints in; absent:
the bundled Noto Sans. Optional and additive within format 0.1 (since 0.3.5; an older build keeps it in
`extra` and prints with the bundled faces).

workshop.description:
The workshop settings (doc 07 §2.5 "The workshop stock"): the stock the shop keeps and what the cut list rounds
to; optional and additive within format 0.1 (an older build keeps it in `extra`).

Screw.description: The screw of a fixing hole.

Sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest sha256:<64 lower-case hex> (doc 05 §3.2).

SourceRef.description:
The import provenance of a record (doc 14 §2.3, ADR-0004 amendment 1): the lineage and the source key
from which the record's ID `v5(lineage namespace, key)` was derived.

key.description: The source key, byte for byte (NFC), such as `qet:el:<uuid>`.

SupplySpec.description: The incoming supply (doc 03 §5), rendered by a format ("1 x 230 VAC + N + PE, 50 Hz").

TagCase.description: Tag case sensitivity (the record form of `ew_mltext::CaseSensitivity`).

oneOf.description: Tags differing only in case are different.
Tags differing only in case collide.

TempRange.description: A temperature range in °C; either end may be open.

TextStyleSpec.description:
One entry of `ProjectSettings.text_styles`: an override of a built-in style or a new style (ADR-0032).

Italic and alignment are not typed (no italic face is bundled, ADR-0028; alignment belongs to the slot) and stay in
`extra`.

face.description: The typeface; absent is [`Typeface::Standard`], so a file without it prints as before.

size.description: The em height in nm, 500,000 … 50,000,000 (0.5 mm … 50 mm).

weight.description: The weight; absent keeps the built-in row's weight (regular for a new style).

TextWeight.description: The weight of a text style (ADR-0032 decision 1).

TubeSpec.description:
A tube specification (doc 11 §2.4), every value optional: the overrides of a line, a medium's default and the
project's default use the same shape, and the effective specification is resolved value by value (doc 11 §5.4).

TwoWires.description: What two wires of one size on one clamp take ([`WorkshopSettings::two_wires`], doc 13 §4.3).

oneOf.description: One twin ferrule for the two, where the clamp takes one.

Typeface.description:
The bundled typeface of a text style (ADR-0028 amendment 2): every face is compiled into the program, so a drawing
looks the same on every machine; system fonts are never used.

oneOf.description: Noto Sans, the default drawing face.
Noto Sans Condensed: narrower letters for long texts in tight places.
Noto Sans Mono: every character as wide as the next, for columns of numbers and addresses.

Routed Gothic: the single-stroke lettering of technical drawings and engraved signs. It has no bold: a bold
style in it prints regular ([`Typeface::has_bold`]).

TypefaceFile.description:
A font file of the user's that the project holds (doc 09 §4.8): the asset `assets/<sha256>.ttf` or `.otf` and the
file's name as the person chose it.

asset.description: The asset: the font file's SHA-256.

name.description:
The file's name without its folder (`LiberationSans-Regular.ttf`): what the window shows and what a DXF's text
style names.

Unit.description:
The units of doc 03 §3.2 and the order units of FR-PRT-026. Persisted as the unit symbol in ASCII
(`"mm2"`, `"degC"`), so files stay greppable; rendering uses the typographic symbol.

oneOf.description: Metre (lengths and the order unit of cables).
Milliampere (a coil's or an input's current; 0.3.5).

UserPropDef.description:
A field of the project's own (doc 03 §5 `UserPropDef`, doc 09 §2.10): a value a title block prints that the
program does not know.

key.description: Made once from the first name, unique in the project, never shown; it stays when the field is renamed.

label.description: Its name as the person typed it.

scope.description: The records that hold its values.

UserPropKind.description: The kind of a field's value (doc 03 §5): text only now.

UserPropScope.description: A record kind that holds a field's values (doc 03 §5).

UserPropValue.description: One value of a field of the project's own (doc 03 §5 `UserPropValue`).

WorkshopSettings.description: The workshop settings of a project ([`ProjectSettings::workshop`]).

cut_increment.description: What the cut list rounds a piece up to; absent: 5 mm.

datum.description: The corner every surface's holes are measured from where the surface sets none; absent: bottom left.

device_labels.description: Where a device's label goes (doc 13 §5.3); absent: on the device.

door_loop.description: The loop a wire into a door keeps across its hinge (doc 12 §9); absent: 300 mm.

duct_fixing.description: How a duct is fixed; absent: M4, at most 300 mm apart, 25 mm from each end.

ferrules.description:
Which fine-stranded ends take a ferrule (doc 13 §4.2); absent: every one but those into a spring or push-in
clamp.

fill_limit.description: The fill a duct's fullest piece may reach, in percent of its inner area (doc 12 §8.6); absent: 60.

fixing.description: How a fixing hole in the mounting plate is made (doc 12-3d §10.3); absent: tapped.

label_profile.description: The columns of a label file with their headings (doc 13 §5.4); absent: the generic profile.

mark_cores.description: Whether a cable's core carries a marker; absent: no, its colour or number names it.

mark_jumpers.description: Whether a jumper on one device carries a marker; absent: no.

marking.description: What a wire's marker says (doc 13 §5.1); absent: the far end.

min_web.description: The web kept between two holes and from a hole to a sheet's edge; absent: 5 mm.

rail_fixing.description: How a rail is fixed; absent: M5, at most 300 mm apart, 25 mm from each end.

reserve.description: What the fitter adds to a routed wire at each end (doc 12 §9); absent: 50 mm.

stock.description:
The wire, ferrule and marker parts the shop keeps, in its order of preference: a wire takes the first stock
wire part of its size and colour, an end the first stock ferrule that fits it, a label kind the first stock
marker that marks it.

two_wires.description: What two wires of one size on one clamp take (doc 13 §4.3); absent: a twin ferrule.

description:
The single project row (doc 03 §5, rank 10): master data, parties, supply and settings.

Not in v0 (later work packages; a file that carries them keeps them in `extra`): `completed` (revisions,
doc 15 §5.10) and the settings schemes listed at [`ProjectSettings`].

$k.description: The kind name; always the first member.

basic_project.description: The basic project this project was created from (FR-PRJ-009, doc 07 §2.8).

derivation_profile.description: The derivation profile, such as `"2027.1"` (FR-PRJ-011); changes only by a previewed upgrade.

kind.description: Schematic, basic (company template) or macro project (FR-PRJ-026).

master.description: Master data printed on the cover and in title blocks.

parties.description: Persons and organisations in their roles (FR-PRJ-003). Personal data (NFR-PRIV-06).

supply.description: The incoming supply; absent in basic and macro projects.

user_prop_defs.description: The fields of the project's own (FR-PRJ-007, doc 09 §2.10).

user_props.description: The project's values of its fields of scope project.

title: project
